podcast.body: Released in 1993, this album was largely recorded in the living room of a friend, reflecting Beck's experimental approach to folk music, which he termed "Anti-Foke." The recording environment and content were part of his early works characterized by live playing, sound collages, noise, and other avant-garde elements. "In 1993, he released an album entitled Golden Feelings, which was largely recorded in the living room of a friend."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
